subject: Nimbus POC: access provisioning, success criteria & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-25T10:15:00-08:00
Subject: Nimbus POC: access provisioning, success criteria & next steps

Hi Samir 

Great to meet yesterday. Quick recap and clear next steps so we can get your POC started next week: 

1) Success criteria (what you and your stakeholders told us):
- Average latency under 250ms for 512-token prompts (survey endpoint)
- 90%+ correctness on our 50-case clinical extraction eval (youll supply test set)
- Integration with your SSO + audit logging visible in Console

2) Evaluation plan & timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): access + SSO invites; IP allowlist and API key for initial tests
- Week 1: ingestion of sample corpus and run of extraction eval (you provide dataset by Mon)
- Week 2: iterative model/config tuning and scalability test (throughput target: 200 rps)
- Week 3: wrap-up & decision meeting

3) Ownership & contacts (for clarity):
- Nimbus: Samir (POC lead), Aisha (security)
- Redwood: Marissa (account lead), Dylan (solutions/benchmarking), Dev (engineer for onboarding)

4) Access we need from your side:
- SSO invite for marissa.cole@redwood.com and dylan.brooks@redwood.com (SAML)
- IP allowlist block: 34.214.10.0/24 and 34.214.11.0/24 (we can use different ranges if you have constraints)
- A service account or test user with minimal access to your sample data (if applicable)

Action items for us: I’ll prepare the mutual action plan (attached) and Dev will create a scoped API key once your SSO and allowlist are in place.

Can you confirm the SSO owner and whether the IP ranges above are acceptable? Also please reply with the expected person to upload the test set and target day.

Thanks  looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[attachment: nimbus-mutual-action-plan.xlsx]

From: Samir Patel <samir@nimbushealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@nimbushealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-25T13:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Nimbus POC: access provisioning, success criteria & next steps

Thanks Marissa  appreciate the clear plan. Aisha is our security lead and will handle SSO and allowlist. A few answers: 

- SSO owner: Aisha Khan (ccd)  please send SAML metadata to her.
- IP ranges: the ranges you proposed are fine, but we prefer to use a single /23 for firewall rule. I'll confirm the exact CIDR by EOD.
- Test set: I will upload the 50-case clinical extraction eval to the shared drive by Monday 11/29.

Two asks from our side:
1) Can you provide a scoped API key with read-only access to the inference endpoint for this POC? We want to run the eval programmatically.
2) Any docs on role-based access in the Redwood Console  we'd like to ensure auditors have view-only access.

If you can provision an account or provide the API key instructions, we can get started as soon as SSO/allowlist are done.

Samir
Director of Engineering | Nimbus Health

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@nimbushealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-26T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Nimbus POC: access provisioning, success criteria & next steps

Hi Samir  looping in on the API key and allowlist steps.

Short checklist for your infra team so we can create the scoped key and SSO mapping:
- Provide SAML metadata (XML) or IdP entity URL for Nimbus SSO (send to aisha@nimbushealth.com and reply here).
- Confirm final CIDR to allow: we can accept the /23, please confirm the single CIDR.
- For the API key we will generate a key scoped to a single project with these limits: conversations: read/write, token limit 8k, no admin actions. If you need different scopes tell me now.

I will provision a temporary API key once Aisha confirms SSO metadata or the allowlist entry is present. Below is a staging plan for key handoff: 
- Step 1: We create scoped key in Redwood staging (valid 30 days)
- Step 2: We provide the key via a one-time secure link (DocuSign/secure file) or we can paste the prefix and have you confirm in Console to retrieve full key
- Step 3: We rotate to a long-lived key if you want after the POC

I can also add view-only Console access for your auditors  Marissa, do you want me to set up 2 audit viewers for Nimbus?

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Onboarding Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-27T11:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Nimbus POC: access provisioning, success criteria & next steps

Thanks both  quick updates: 
- Aisha confirmed SSO owner and shared SAML metadata; Dev can proceed (Aisha also attached internal SSO runbook to her email).
- Samir: CIDR confirmed as 34.214.10.0/23  firewall team will apply by EOD 11/27.
- Dev: please provision the temp API key scoped to the POC project and send via one-time secure link.
- Dylan: please add view-only Console access for two auditors (names Samir will provide).

Ive updated the mutual action plan with these dates (attached). Next checkpoint: short sync on Mon 11/29 after the test set is uploaded. If everything looks good well kick the eval that afternoon.

Best,
Marissa
[attachment: nimbus-mutual-action-plan.xlsx]

Hi Samir  quick note to confirm provisioning is complete.

- Scoped API key (staging) created for project: NIM-POC-2026-11
- Key prefix: rk_live_8f2b**** (we delivered the full key to your secure link at 2026-11-30T16:30:00 via one-time access)
- Console: added two view-only auditor accounts (pending your confirmation of names)

Attachments:
- sso-invite-instructions.pdf (step-by-step for your IdP admin)

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Onboarding Engineer | Redwood Inference
